messages:
fraud-bot: Automated flag: free-trial blocked for acct (sandbox) — risk score 78. Reasons: multiple X-Forwarded-For values, user-agent mismatch, disposable-email indicator. Tagging support for manual review.

alex_s: Hi team — customer reports they can't apply promo or start trial. Received 'trial blocked by abuse checks'. Can someone share quick repro clues?

maya_ops: I pulled the alert. Client request shows headers that look like a cloud VM + proxy chain. Sample:```
GET /api/v1/signup
Host: api.redwood.ai
User-Agent: curl/7.88.1
X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.45, 10.0.0.5, 198.51.100.12
Referer: https://signup.example.com/
```

sam_fraud: Those XFF chains are common with some browser privacy extensions or mobile carriers but combined with disposable email token it's raising confidence. Email domain: `tempmail-9u2.net` (bounce history).

alex_s: Customer says they used their company laptop and a normal browser, not curl. Could be a misdetected UA — maybe our ingestion converted it. Any quick checks before asking customer for KBA?

maya_ops: Check the request raw payloads in the logs vs what the frontend sends. Also look at IP ASN — `198.51.100.12` maps to a cloud provider (AS64500). If they used a VPN or a cloud devbox, that explains it.

sam_fraud: For manual override we need either phone verification + matching IP age, or KBA. We can also request a selfie with company ID but that's heavy. Recommend phone OTP first.

alex_s: I'll ask the customer for a phone number for OTP and request they retry from their home network (no corp VPN). Any guidance on message to send?

ops-oncall: Short suggested copy: "Hi — our system blocked your trial because the signup looked like it came from an anonymized network. To proceed we can send a one-time code to your phone or do a quick verification. Reply with the best number (SMS preferred)." :thumbsup:

alex_s: Sending that now. Also flagged for manual override if OTP passes. Sam, can you queue a one-time grace trial if they pass OTP?

sam_fraud: Yes — if OTP verified and email not flagged on our current disposables list we can grant a 7-day trial manually and clear the fraud flag. I'll mark this thread and note the override code path.

fraud-bot: Note: added tag `manual_review_requested` -> queue id 4729.

maya_ops: FYI, logging note for infra — we should add a small heuristic to ignore `User-Agent: curl` if request originates from known browser referrer and has matching JS fingerprint. Filing a quick ticket.

alex_s: Thanks all. I'll update when customer replies with OTP result.

(15 minutes later)

alex_s: Customer responded, provided phone ending in ··34 and completed OTP. They also said they were on their company VPN earlier but disabled it and retried from home; signup succeeded after OTP. Please proceed with manual 7-day grant.

sam_fraud: Manual grant completed, promo/promo-apply logs show success. Cleared flag and added note: "verified OTP, user-agent mismatch likely caused by VPN/proxy chain". Closing flow.

alex_s: Closing thread, leaving follow-up ticket for dev to refine UA/JS fingerprint heuristics. Thanks everyone!"
